messages:
Rina (Infra PM): quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A: several customers asked for a short ops checklist for the holiday surge specifically for APAC. can leadership confirm which routing knobs we want teams to use and what the CS line should be? cc @Omar

Omar (VP Infra): short: prefer regional warm for latency tiers, allow regional preempt for cost-tolerant routes. ops checklist: 1) validate `min_warm` per-region 2) enable `preempt_detection` alerts 3) confirm billing tags for spill events. more below.

Kay (SRE): implementation details: routing precedence is `regional-warm -> regional-preempt -> remote-warm -> remote-preempt`. preempt detection threshold: `preempt_rate > 0.18` over 60s window. when volatile, we auto-increase `min_warm` by +1 for premium routes for 10m.

Dev (Platform): console changes: we'll add `route.metrics.warm_pool_pct`, `route.metrics.spill_count`, and an `allocate_from_burst` flag in the API. ETA: mockups tomorrow. API example: `PATCH /routes/:id {"allocate_from_burst":true}`

Alex (Support): customer message request: can we get a single non-tech sentence to use in support replies when a customer sees brief latency spikes due to spill?

Omar (VP Infra): suggested CS line: "During short regional demand spikes we temporarily use lower-cost regional capacity to keep your traffic flowing; premium plans stay on our local warm pool for low latency." use as-is.

Rina (Infra PM): ops checklist I'm drafting: - confirm `min_warm` >= 2 for APAC - enable preempt alerts (channel #infra-alerts) - run preempt sim test - review routes with `tier=premium` and set `fallback_policy=prefer_region` if needed. will post PR.

Kay (SRE): test commands: `./infra/tools/preempt-sim --region=apac1 --spike=0.35 --dur=180 --observe` to validate header propagation and KV miss rates. also `make stress TEST=holiday/warm-pool-stress` for sustained load.

Dev (Platform): billing note: spill events are annotated `spill_reason=preempt` and `node_tag=spill-preempt` in usage exports; finance will map to the preempt SKU. we'll add FAQ entry.

Rina (Infra PM): action items: 1) Dev -> post API/console mock (tomorrow) 2) Kay -> share preempt dashboard link + sim instructions 3) Alex -> integrate CS one-liner into templates. target: EOD Wed.

deploy-bot: rollout queued: autoscaler/v2 -> staging at 2026-07-20T11:02:00Z. monitors: warm-pool-util, preempt-rate. :robot_face:

Alex (Support): thanks, I'll hold messaging until FAQ lands. small ask: can we get a short one-line on burst credits behavior if they come up?

Omar (VP Infra): burst credits: they let selected customers draw from a warm-reserve without increasing committed billing; routing unchanged. one-liner: "If you have burst credits, we use them to keep your traffic on local warm capacity during short surges."

Rina (Infra PM): perfect. I'll collect notes and post the holiday ops checklist + CS FAQ in #all-hands follow-up. please add any runbook steps to infra/runbooks/warm-pool-ops.md.

Kay (SRE): added a runbook PR: infra/runbooks/warm-pool-ops.md -> staging. includes recovery steps for "regional-volatile".

Omar (VP Infra): procurement update: we pushed an RFX for APAC boards; if approved we can expand warm-pool by ~25% in Q4 and run a 2-customer pilot for guaranteed regional SLA. will update next all-hands.

Rina (Infra PM): thanks everyone :thumbsup:
